documents.title: Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI Listing Regulations - Appointment Of Secretarial Auditor By The Shareholders Of The Company.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Raymond Realty reported a total income of INR3,039 crores for FY26, representing a 29% growth over the previous year, while quarterly income for Q4 surged 53% to INR1,176 crores with an EBITDA of INR495 crores. The company achieved a structural shift in its portfolio mix with non-Thane JDA pre-sales bookings reaching 54% in FY26, achieving its 50-50 mix target one year ahead of schedule. Management highlighted a net debt of INR656 crores, a gross debt-to-equity ratio of 0.6, and a liquidity buffer of INR358 crores at the end of the year. Furthermore, the company launched major projects including Address by GS Wadala, Address by GS Sion, TenX District 9, and Park Street, releasing a combined gross development value of INR6,400 crores during the quarter. Raymond Realty reported a pre-sales of ₹1,519 Cr.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates a minimum 20% growth on pre-sales numbers and top-line for FY27.
guidance.quote: and we've always given a guidance that you can expect a minimum 20% growth from us on the pre-sales number and on the top-line as well.

guidance.claim: Management expects two projects in Mahim to be launched by Q3.
guidance.quote: Over the next 12 to 15 months, we are on track to launch two more projects which are both in Mahim and they are at very advanced stages in terms of approvals. So, they will definitely get launched by Q3.

guidance.claim: The Kandivali development launch will spill over from FY27 into FY28.
guidance.quote: Both these projects should be in the market, and which will be followed by the Kandivali development, which will spill over to the, not FY27, but will be going into FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the MMR market has stayed steady and is primarily actual user-driven.
demand_outlook.quote: MMR is the market in which Raymond Realty operates in a major way, and the demand has stayed steady in this market. It’s primarily actual user-driven and buyers are prioritizing functionality, connectivity, and most importantly, reliability in terms of choosing the developers that they want to buy from.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects a sustainable impact on costs if commodity price escalations continue, but notes that the absorption capacity exists in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: So, construction cost impact will actually play out over the longer period of time. But we've done some scenario building and we are expecting about 3% to 4% impact on costs if this goes on for a long period of time. If it dies out in the next two months or three months, you will not even see that kind of impact. But the absorption capacity for that cost increase is there in the market and we will pass it on.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintained a resilient EBITDA margin profile of 21.5% in Q4.
margins_costs.quote: While we were scaling rapidly, we also maintained a resilient EBITDA margin profile of 21.5% in Q4.

margins_costs.claim: The blended EBITDA margin for FY26 reported by the company was around 16%.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, so see if you look at the EBITDA margin that we have reported for FY26, it’s around 16% is what we have reported on a blended basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Currently about 60 acres of the 100-acre land parcel in Thane is under development at different stages.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, about 60 acres of that land is under development at different stages.

orders_capacity.claim: The JDA portfolio comprises seven projects with a combined revenue potential of approximately INR17,000 crores based on current prices.
orders_capacity.quote: So our JDA portfolio now comprises of seven projects with a combined revenue potential of approximately INR17,000 crores based on current prices.

capital_allocation.claim: The company concluded the year with a net debt of INR656 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We concluded the year with a net debt of INR656 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The gross debt-to-equity ratio stands at 0.6.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt equity on gross basis stands at 0.6, which is comfortably below our internal ceiling of 1:1 debt to equity, so we are very comfortable there.

capital_allocation.claim: The liquidity buffer stood at INR358 crores at the end of the year.
capital_allocation.quote: And our liquidity buffer was INR358 crores at the end of the year, which makes us fully funded as far as next year is concerned in terms of whatever money we need.

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals from Thane release about INR450 crores to INR500 crores of cash every year.
capital_allocation.quote: That Thane, which is my own land, releases about INR450 crores to INR500 crores of cash for me every year. So that's the internal accruals which I get from Thane straight away.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans two new projects on own land in Thane during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: • 2 New Projects on own land - Thane

management_commitments.claim: Management plans two new JDA projects in Mumbai during FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
